bvdr-daily-planner-skill-remarkable-dail.description: Build a modular daily-planner one-sheet for an e-ink tablet and deliver it via Folio. Use when the user asks for a daily plan, daily planner, "daily one sheet", morning sheet, day plan, or to send a planner to their reMarkable, Supernote, Kindle Scribe or other e-ink device. Interviews the user, pulls from connected tools (calendar, tasks, GitHub, weather), renders an e-ink-optimized PDF sized for the chosen device, and sends it with Folio.
